2607.21013.title: EmoAgent-R1: Towards Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Reinforcement Learning-based Dynamic Agent Specialization
2607.21013.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance in multimodal emotion recognition (MER) tasks and lifted MER to a new level that is complex emotion understanding with advanced video understanding abilities and natural language description. However, existing MLLM-based methods often use a fixed prompt to perceive the emotions, ignoring the dynamicity and complexity of the emotion source in the multimodal inputs. To address these issues, we propose a novel Reinforcement Learning-based Dynamic Agent Specialization framework (\textbf{EmoAgent-R1}) to optimize the emotion recognition, reasoning, and generalization abilities of an MLLM with dynamic agent specialization based on reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first adopt a cold start strategy to endow an MLLM with preliminary emotion recognition, reasoning, and agent routing ability by training with synthetic answer-conditioned chain-of-thought data and agent routing data. Then, we further train the MLLM with reinforcement learning to perceive emotions in a two-step agentic workflow with agent selection and agent specialization. To effectively train EmoAgent-R1, we propose a novel Progressive Group-Relative Policy Optimization (P-GRPO) to combine group-based relative advantages with a PMI-inspired progressive token-level modulation to transform sparse rewards into fine-grained learning signals, mitigating the coarse-grained uniform credit assignment issue in GRPO. Extensive experiments on MER benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our EmoAgent-R1 in stronger emotion reasoning performance and improved optimization stability.
2607.21013.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在多模態情感識別（MER）任務中取得了令人印象深刻的表現，並將MER提升到一個新的層次，即具有先進視頻理解能力和自然語言描述的複雜情感理解。然而，現有的基於MLLM的方法往往使用固定的提示來感知情感，忽略了多模態輸入中情感來源的動態性和複雜性。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一個新穎的基於強化學習的動態代理專業化框架（\textbf{EmoAgent-R1}），旨在通過基於強化學習的動態代理專業化來優化MLLM的情感識別、推理和泛化能力。具體而言，我們首先採用冷啟動策略，通過使用合成的答案條件鏈式思考數據和代理路由數據來賦予MLLM初步的情感識別、推理和代理路由能力。然後，我們進一步通過強化學習訓練MLLM，在一個包含代理選擇和代理專業化的兩步代理工作流程中感知情感。為了有效地訓練EmoAgent-R1，我們提出了一種新穎的漸進式群體相對策略優化（P-GRPO），將基於群體的相對優勢與受PMI啟發的漸進式令牌級調製相結合，以將稀疏獎勵轉化為細粒度的學習信號，減輕GRPO中粗粒度均勻信用分配的問題。在MER基準上的廣泛實驗證明了我們的EmoAgent-R1在更強的情感推理性能和改進的優化穩定性方面的優越性。
